nodes.name: agentOrgs.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schema module defining org/agent config records, CLI launch profiles, session provenance hooks/signals, skill listings, and Cursor plugin metadata used by Tauri RPC commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure Zod schema/type declarations (43 exports, no functions or classes); imports shared enums from validation.ts to compose org-specific input/output schemas.

nodes.name: sessionAggregate.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schema module for the session_aggregate_list / session_get_aggregate_stats Tauri commands, including filters, aggregate records, and external history sidebar responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors Rust structs in src-tauri/src/agent_sessions/session_directory/; relies on serde camelCase renaming so no field transforms are needed on the TS side.

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zod schema module covering CLI agent/API-provider types, key vault CRUD, OAuth exchange flows, and housekeeper (AI assist) RPC commands; single source of truth for runtime validation and static types shared across other schema files.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest schema file in the module (86 exports, zero imports); mirrors Rust types in src-tauri/src/key_vault/commands/ and is depended on by sibling schema files (agentOrgs.ts, sessionAggregate.ts).
